pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a good use of your talents? (1 mark)
   A. Boasting about them
   B. Using them to hurt people
   C. Hiding them always
   D. Helping others with them

2. Which book of the Bible begins with the words "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth"? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis
   B. Psalms
   C. Luke
   D. Exodus

3. Who said, "As for me and my household, we will serve the Lord"? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua
   B. Abraham
   C. Peter
   D. Stephen

4. Why is it important to know your family members? (1 mark)
   A. So you can forget them
   B. So you can avoid them
   C. So you can boast
   D. It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related

5. What brings harmony in a family? (1 mark)
   A. Respect and love among members
   B. Jealousy
   C. Fighting
   D. Selfishness

6. What does 1 Corinthians 6:19 say our bodies are? (1 mark)
   A. Toys
   B. Property of strangers
   C. Temples of the Holy Spirit
   D. Machines

7. Someone offers you sweets and asks you to keep a secret. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Go with them
   B. Ask for more
   C. Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   D. Accept and hide it

8. Which of these is the first book of the New Testament? (1 mark)
   A. Romans
   B. Genesis
   C. Matthew
   D. Acts

9. Which of these is an honest use of money? (1 mark)
   A. Stealing from a friend
   B. Cheating in a game
   C. Lying about the price
   D. Returning extra change to a shopkeeper

10. What did the angel tell Balaam to do at the end? (1 mark)
   A. Go with the men but speak only what God tells him
   B. Kill the donkey
   C. Curse Israel
   D. Go home forever

11. What did God first tell Balaam about going with Balak's messengers? (1 mark)
   A. Go at once
   B. Curse Israel
   C. Take a gift
   D. Do not go with them

12. In which book of the Bible is the story of Samson found? (1 mark)
   A. Psalms
   B. Judges
   C. Luke
   D. Genesis

13. What did the seven thin cows stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Seven towns
   B. Seven years of famine
   C. Seven servants
   D. Seven years of plenty

14. Where was Joseph when the cupbearer remembered him? (1 mark)
   A. In Canaan
   B. In prison
   C. In the palace
   D. In his father's house

15. How old was Abram when he left Haran? (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 50
   C. 100
   D. 25

16. Where were the ten men when they called to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. In their homes
   B. In the temple
   C. Right beside Him
   D. At a distance

17. What is a widow? (1 mark)
   A. A woman without children
   B. A queen
   C. A woman whose husband has died
   D. A teacher

18. Which verse says, "I am the resurrection and the life"? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 7:14
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. John 11:25
   D. Acts 2:38

19. Who forgave his brothers who had sold him? (1 mark)
   A. Daniel
   B. Joseph
   C. Balaam
   D. Samson

20. According to Acts 20:35, what is more blessed? (1 mark)
   A. To buy than to sell
   B. To give than to receive
   C. To sleep than to work
   D. To keep than to give

21. Why should we help promptly? (1 mark)
   A. Needs may be urgent
   B. Helping is a waste
   C. Nobody needs help
   D. Delay is better

22. Which of these is a righteous way of living? (1 mark)
   A. Stealing
   B. Cheating
   C. Lying
   D. Telling the truth

23. What did Jesus say a person must be to see the kingdom of God? (1 mark)
   A. A priest
   B. Old
   C. Born again
   D. Rich

24. What did Nicodemus say to defend Jesus in John 7:50-51? (1 mark)
   A. He is a liar
   B. Let us punish Him
   C. Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
   D. He is a king

25. What question did Nicodemus ask about being born again? (1 mark)
   A. Where is Jerusalem?
   B. Who is God?
   C. Who are you?
   D. How can someone be born when old?

26. Who was tempted by Potiphar's wife? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. Abraham
   C. Daniel
   D. Samson

27. What does integrity mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being popular
   B. Being lucky
   C. Copying others
   D. Doing right when nobody is watching

28. Which is a school rule? (1 mark)
   A. Litter
   B. Arrive on time
   C. Skip lessons
   D. Fight freely

29. Which is a benefit of obeying parents? (1 mark)
   A. Peace at home
   B. Trouble
   C. Lost trust
   D. Poor marks

30. Who did the disciples rebuke? (1 mark)
   A. The people bringing children
   B. The Pharisees
   C. The children
   D. The soldiers

31. In 1 Corinthians 6:19, what does Paul call the body of a believer? (1 mark)
   A. Machines
   B. Property of strangers
   C. Temples of the Holy Spirit
   D. Toys

32. What should you do when you sin? (1 mark)
   A. Blame others
   B. Confess, say sorry and put things right
   C. Repeat it
   D. Hide it

33. Why should a child tell a trusted adult if someone touches them wrongly? (1 mark)
   A. To boast
   B. For no reason
   C. It is not their fault and the adult can protect them
   D. To get someone in trouble

34. Which verse mentions activities such as a hymn and a word of instruction? (1 mark)
   A. 1 Corinthians 14:26
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. John 3:16
   D. Genesis 1:1

35. Who preached to the crowd at Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. Thomas
   B. Judas
   C. Stephen
   D. Peter

36. What does Acts 2:38 tell people to do? (1 mark)
   A. Sell everything
   B. Repent and be baptised
   C. Stay at home
   D. Fast for a month

37. Who was stoned for standing firm in his faith? (1 mark)
   A. Paul
   B. Stephen
   C. Andrew
   D. Peter

38. What does it mean to stand firm in faith? (1 mark)
   A. To keep believing and doing right under pressure
   B. To give up
   C. To copy others
   D. To hide

39. What does "hallowed" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rich
   B. Holy
   C. Old
   D. Loud

40. Which is a good use of a digital device? (1 mark)
   A. Chatting with strangers
   B. Listening to a gospel song
   C. Bullying
   D. Spreading rumours

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Why is being joyful important for a Christian? Give three reasons. (3 marks)

42. Name two things that Samson did in Judges 14:5-9. (2 marks)

43. Explain the meaning of "Give us today our daily bread". (3 marks)

44. State three reasons why we should care for school property. (3 marks)

45. What does the name Nazirite refer to in the story of Samson? (2 marks)

46. Explain the difference between the nuclear family and the extended family, with one example of each member. (4 marks)

47. Explain how the story of Samson and the lion shows God's power. (3 marks)

48. Explain why young people should lead holy lives, and give four ways of doing it. (5 marks)

49. Name two things that Zacchaeus promised to do after meeting Jesus. (2 marks)

50. Describe how the woman searched for the coin and what she did when she found it. (4 marks)

51. Explain why a child should never blame themselves if they were touched wrongly, and say what they should do. (5 marks)

52. Give four ways in which we can care for our eyes and health. (4 marks)

53. Write the first three books of the New Testament in order. (2 marks)

54. Explain how repentance draws a person close to Christ and how a child can repent. (5 marks)

55. Explain what the word "sole" means when we say God is the sole Creator. (3 marks)

56. State two ways of coping with anger. (2 marks)

57. Give two meanings of the word church. (2 marks)

58. Explain four ways of building self-control. (4 marks)

59. Give two words that describe Joseph's character in this story. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Helping others with them
   Talents are gifts from God meant to serve others.

2. A — Genesis
   Genesis 1:1 is the opening line of the Bible.

3. A — Joshua
   Joshua 24:15 records these words.

4. D — It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related
   Knowing family helps in respect and relationships.

5. A — Respect and love among members
   Respect and love make a home peaceful.

6. C — Temples of the Holy Spirit
   The verse teaches that the body is a temple of the Holy Spirit.

7. C — Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   Gifts with secrets are a warning sign.

8. C — Matthew
   Matthew is the first of the four Gospels and of the New Testament.

9. D — Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   Honesty means returning what is not ours.

10. A — Go with the men but speak only what God tells him
   God allowed him to go but ordered him to speak only His words.

11. D — Do not go with them
   God told him not to go and not to curse the people.

12. B — Judges
   Judges 13-16 tells about Samson.

13. B — Seven years of famine
   The thin cows were seven years of famine.

14. B — In prison
   Joseph was in prison in Egypt.

15. A — 75
   Genesis 12:4 says he was seventy-five.

16. D — At a distance
   They stood at a distance and called out.

17. C — A woman whose husband has died
   A widow has lost her husband.

18. C — John 11:25
   John 11:25 records Jesus' words.

19. B — Joseph
   Joseph forgave his brothers in Egypt.

20. B — To give than to receive
   Acts 20:35 quotes Jesus' words.

21. A — Needs may be urgent
   Quick help reduces suffering.

22. D — Telling the truth
   Righteous living pleases God.

23. C — Born again
   John 3:3 records this.

24. C — Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
   Nicodemus asked for a fair hearing.

25. D — How can someone be born when old?
   He was puzzled about a second birth.

26. A — Joseph
   Genesis 39 tells the story of Joseph.

27. D — Doing right when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty in private.

28. B — Arrive on time
   Being on time is a common school rule.

29. A — Peace at home
   Obedience brings harmony.

30. A — The people bringing children
   They told off those who brought the children.

31. C — Temples of the Holy Spirit
   The body is a temple.

32. B — Confess, say sorry and put things right
   1 John 1:9 says God forgives those who confess.

33. C — It is not their fault and the adult can protect them
   Telling keeps children safe.

34. A — 1 Corinthians 14:26
   1 Corinthians 14:26 lists activities in worship.

35. D — Peter
   Peter spoke boldly.

36. B — Repent and be baptised
   Peter's answer to the crowd.

37. B — Stephen
   Acts 7:54-60.

38. A — To keep believing and doing right under pressure
   Standing firm means not giving in.

39. B — Holy
   Hallowed be your name means may your name be honoured as holy.

40. B — Listening to a gospel song
   Gospel songs are uplifting.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: It keeps us healthy in mind; it cheers others; it helps us face problems; it shows trust in God. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: He killed a lion with his bare hands; he ate honey from the lion's body and shared it with his parents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: We ask God to give us what we need each day, such as food. We depend on Him and we thank Him for what we have.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for needs, 1 for food or daily, 1 for thanks or dependence.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: It belongs to everyone; repair costs money; a clean school helps learning; others will use it later.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: A person set apart for God from birth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for set apart and 1 mark for for God.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: The nuclear family is parents and children living together, for example a mother. The extended family includes other relatives such as grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins, for example an uncle.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for describing nuclear, 1 for example, 1 for describing extended, 1 for example.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Samson had no weapon, but the Spirit of the Lord gave him strength to tear a lion apart. This shows God's power is greater than any danger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for no weapon, 1 for the Spirit giving strength, 1 for God's power.

48. (5 marks)
   Answer: God is holy and asks us to be holy. Our bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit. A holy life keeps us safe and pleases God. Ways: keep clean, avoid drugs and alcohol, choose good friends, avoid harmful media, pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's call, 1 for the temple idea, 1 for safety, 2 for ways.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Give half his possessions to the poor and pay back four times to anyone he cheated.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each promise.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: She lit a lamp, swept the house, searched carefully until she found it, then called her friends and neighbours to rejoice with her.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

51. (5 marks)
   Answer: The person who did wrong is always guilty. A child cannot control an adult or older person who chooses to do wrong. The child should tell a trusted adult, who will believe and protect them, and can call 116 for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the person doing wrong being guilty, 1 for the child not being to blame, 1 for telling a trusted adult, 1 for the helper protecting, 1 for the helpline.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep hands clean; do not read in dim light; go to the clinic when eyes hurt; eat vegetables and fruit; rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct in order, 2 marks for all three correct.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: Sin separates us from God. When we are sorry and turn from wrong, God forgives and we draw near to Him. A child can admit wrong, say sorry to God and others, put things right, and decide to do better with the Spirit's help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sin separating, 1 for forgiveness, 1 for admitting, 1 for putting right, 1 for deciding to do better.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sole means only. God alone made everything. Nobody helped Him and nobody made Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning of sole, 1 for God alone creating, 1 for no helper.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathe deeply, count to ten, walk away, talk to a trusted adult, pray. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: The building where Christians worship; the community of believers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray each morning, set small goals, keep busy with good activities, choose good friends, avoid tempting situations.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wise, honest, humble, faithful, hardworking, trusting in God. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid word.
